en.description:
I made this version of Olsen to be a relaxing card game you can play whenever you want to pass the time. Now you can also sit down at the same table with up to three friends, each on your own iPhone, iPad, or Mac.

Olsen is a Norwegian card game in the Crazy Eights family. Match suit or rank, play an 8 to choose a new suit, and be first to empty your hand. When you are down to one card, you say Olsen. The rules are simple, so you can just chill and play without thinking too hard.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Invite friends through Game Center and the round starts as soon as one of them has joined. Fill any empty seats with AI players if you want a fuller game. When the round is over you can go again, and the score follows along. If someone loses the connection, an AI player takes over their seat so the game can go on. Three of the achievements are only for games with friends.

PLAY ALONE
Play against one, two, or three AI opponents with names, different difficulty levels, and a bit of personality. You can also choose the look you like best with kids, adult, and senior themes.

WHAT YOU GET
• Play with up to three friends over Game Center
• Short rounds that fit a commute, a break, or a quiet evening
• One-handed play on iPhone
• Built-in tutorial and a clear rules screen
• Works on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch
• 23 Game Center achievements
• No internet needed when you play alone

No sign-up. Just Olsen when you feel like a calm round of cards, alone or with friends.
en.releaseNotes:
Play with friends: invite up to three friends through Game Center and play Olsen together, each on your own device. Empty seats can be filled with AI players.
After a round you can go again with a running score. If someone drops out, an AI player takes over their seat.
Three new achievements for playing with friends.
en.subtitle: Play solo or with friends

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Improvements and fixes in this update:

• Game Center achievements now work on every platform, including Apple Watch
• Achievements earned while signed out of GameCenter are saved and uploaded when you sign in
• You can replay the tutorial from the How to Play screen
• Fixed a bug where wrong cards could be played when the first card in a round was an 8
- Quit button sometimes failed to register taps

Improvements and fixes in this update:
• New setting on Apple Watch: turn haptic feedback on or off
• Achievements now sync more reliably, so wins on Apple Watch count even when the watch is offline
• The achievement for five wins in a row no longer resets when you restart the app
A short welcome screen for new players.
